name: not on a path
template:
$/ if not x
NEG
$/ else
POS
$/ endif

name: not on a false path
template:
$/ if not x
NEG
$/ endif

name: ! is the same as not
template:
$/ if !x
NEG
$/ endif

name: ! with a space after it
template:
$/ if ! x
NEG
$/ endif

name: != is still a comparison
template:
$/ if a != b
DIFF
$/ endif

name: not is case-insensitive
template:
$/ if NOT x
NEG
$/ endif

name: not on a function call
template:
$/ if not contains(name,"temp")
KEEP
$/ endif

name: not on a comparison negates the whole comparison
template:
$/ if not a == b
DIFF
$/ endif

name: not binds tighter than and
template:
$/ if not a and b
YES
$/ else
NO
$/ endif

name: not binds tighter than or
template:
$/ if not a or b
YES
$/ else
NO
$/ endif

name: not after and
template:
$/ if a and not b
YES
$/ else
NO
$/ endif

name: not on loop metadata as a separator
template:
$/ foreach i in list
$i.n$$/ if not i.last() ,$/ endif
$/ endfor

name: not or last keeps the separator on a historized list
template:
$/ foreach i in list
$i.n$$/ if not i.last() or tail ,$/ endif
$/ endfor

name: not in a foreach where
template:
$/ foreach i in list where not i.hidden
$i.n$
$/ endfor

name: not in an inline if
template: A$/ if not x B $/ else C $/ endif D

name: not in an inline if, true side of the path
template: A$/ if not x B $/ else C $/ endif D

name: an empty array is falsy
template:
$/ if list
HAS
$/ else
NONE
$/ endif

name: a non-empty array is truthy
template:
$/ if list
HAS
$/ else
NONE
$/ endif

name: not on an empty array
template:
$/ if not list
NONE
$/ endif

name: a condition that cannot be parsed is an error, not false
template:
$/ if x y z
NEVER
$/ endif
